content:
claire: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A 
Can we agree on a short "finance playbook" blurb customers and sales can use that clearly differentiates credits, quotas, and reserved capacity? We keep getting fuzzy language in deal notes.
omar: Agreed. Draft blurb: Credits are prepaid consumption buckets used on Hosted plans (trial, promo, prepaid); quotas are enforced windows (requests/min, tokens/day) applied per org/route/pool; reserved capacity refers to Dedicated pool commitments that provide guaranteed throughput and configurable burst windows.
felix: A couple of follow-ups customers asked: 1) Can promo or trial credits carry over? 2) Do we ever auto-convert leftover credits into invoice credits? 3) How does emergency bursting work?
june: Answers: 1) By default trial and promo credits expire at the stated TTL (no automatic rollover). 2) Auto-conversion of hosted prepaid credits to invoice credit is not standard; exceptions are handled via commercial terms and Finance approvals. 3) Hosted supports short, conditional bursts if cluster headroom exists; bursts are governed by per-tier safety ceilings and by credit-bucket type (e.g., promo buckets may be excluded from bursting). If headroom is exhausted we apply graceful fallbacks: route to compatible smaller models, queue, or apply per-route throttles rather than hard-killing in-flight prompts.
claire: Interesting note about promo buckets being excluded from bursting  we should call that out in the finance playbook so Sales knows to warn customers.
omar: Also important: Dedicated pools can opt into a configurable emergency buffer during provisioning, but that buffer is consumed from committed capacity and is not billable as extra credits; overage rules still apply.
felix: Is there a public API customers can call to show remaining credits/quotas so Support can recommend surfacing a banner?
june: Planned endpoint (distinct path): GET /v1/orgs/{org_id}/billing/usage returns: credit_buckets (list), remaining_balance, token_windows, active_rate_limits, per-route thresholds, and a short human_summary string. We'll add a client helper that composes the short sentence for UIs.
ops-bot: infra-note: added alert rule: org-level token usage projected to exhaust within 24h -> alert at 60%+ and 90% thresholds. Panel added to the finance dashboard.
claire: Can we include small sample numbers (clearly marked illustrative) in the playbook? Sales wants a fresh set for the new slide deck.
felix: Example (illustrative): Trial bucket = 120,000 tokens/day; burst ceiling = 30,000 tokens/45s; Startup tier = 900,000 tokens/day; burst = 250,000 tokens/90s; Enterprise = negotiated. Callout: promo credits may be excluded from burst eligibility.
omar: Also add a one-line operational guarantee: we do not preempt in-flight responses due to quota enforcement; we finish current requests then apply backpressure.
claire: Can Docs and Finance produce a two-panel "finance playbook" PDF (one panel canonical blurb + examples, one panel API snippet + alert guidance) we can add to the sales playbook?
june: I'll draft the doc and include the GET example + sample JSON response and a note about throttling_reason codes (RATE_LIMIT, POOL_EXHAUSTION, FALLBACK_MODEL).
finance-bot: note: finance reminder  standard self-serve hosted credits are non-refundable; enterprise exceptions documented in contracts.
dev-bot: created GH issue #4709 "docs: finance playbook - credits/quota/usage API samples" assigned to june and omar.
claire: Perfect, thanks everyone. Please ping when the PR lands so Sales can update the deck. :raised_hands:
